context: Request: year-by-year share of the firm's executed credit-agreement financings that carry an always-on (not springing) financial maintenance covenant, for a client market read; excluded structures named in the request (warehouse, repurchase, securitization, project and real-estate-secured financings). Rubric: twelve financings in year buckets (1006-00001, 1021-00001, 1042-00001, 1008-00001, 1012-00001, 1038-00002, 1010-00001, 1043-00001, 1005-00001, 1036-00001, 1013-00001, 1019-00002), the year-over-year shares, and population precision; 1043-00001 (data-center term loan) and 1036-00001 (REIT facility) count as in scope, while 1001-00007, 1003-00003, 1041-00003, 1012-00002, 1006-00002, 1010-00002 and 1020-00002 are outside the population.

runs.failure_point: A file-name filter that excluded real-estate and similar words dropped one in-scope facility from the list it worked from; it also excluded a data-center term loan as project financing and counted out-of-population agreements.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The review at [61] said the file-name filter that excluded memo, security and similar words silently dropped differently named agreements; the agent read from the filtered list.
first_error.why: The path searches and the snippet script had reached the facility, but the follow-up file-name filter excluded mortgage, real-estate and similar words, so the facility dropped out and the answer was built without it.

other_errors.critic_note: Write and check reviews asked only to confirm rows and exclusions; none questioned this exclusion.
other_errors.why: The answer drops a data-center term loan read at [64]-[83] as project financing although it is an in-scope executed financing.

other_errors.critic_note: (generic flag) The screening review at [87] flagged mezzanine and amended instruments counted without covenant reads; the agent kept them.
other_errors.why: The answer counts restructuring, amended and acquisition-related credit agreements from other matters in the population, changing the yearly denominators (evidence seen at [64]-[104]).

divergence: All three runs failed the same way at the write stage, with the same ten year-bucket criteria passing: each counted out-of-population agreements (amended and restated, restructuring and acquisition-related credit agreements from other matters) and excluded the same data-center term loan as a project financing, so the yearly shares and population precision failed. Each also lost the REIT facility, in different places: T0 grepped inside it and called it draft-only, T1 judged it a real-estate financing from its listing, and T2 dropped it with a file-name filter during scanning (flagged by that stage's review). Reviews raised scope inflation (specifically once, in T1) but no run changed its population.
